title: Oura is going public, but these smart ring companies are coming for its crown
summary: While Oura has largely dominated the smart ring market for years, a growing number of rivals are now racing to dethrone it by trying all sorts of approaches to get an edge over it.
llm_summary: Oura’s upcoming IPO cements its status as the long‑time leader in smart‑ring health trackers, but a wave of new competitors is closing in. Start‑ups and established wearables firms are experimenting with everything from advanced sleep‑stage analytics to integrated wellness ecosystems, each aiming to out‑feature or undercut Oura’s flagship ring. The race is set to reshape the niche market just as Oura goes public.
